## Workload

Hannah Lowe graded 200 sets during 297 rostered hours. This represents an average output of 0.7 sets per hour. The workload was recorded against the rostered hours for the review period, with no change recommended to the existing session pattern.

## Quality

A sample of 17 sets was read again as part of the quality review. Agreement between the original grading and the review was 58.8 per cent. The findings were considered alongside the workload information, and the grader and reviewer agreed to retain the current session pattern.

The review was completed by Priya Anand.
